title: Matsue, Shimane — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Matsue is a city in Shimane with a population of 205,000. A historic castle city on Lake Shinji, known for its beautiful sunset views, green tea, and traditional culture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
